title: K Radius Subarray Averages
summary: Given an array nums of n integers and an integer k, compute the k-radius average for each subarray centered at index i.
statement: Given an array nums of n integers and an integer k, compute the k-radius average for each subarray centered at index i. The k-radius average is the integer division of the sum of elements within the subarray by k, or -1 if the subarray is too short. Return an array avgs of length n where avgs[i] is the k-radius average for the subarray centered at index i.
constraints: For center i, use the 2*k+1 elements from i-k through i+k.
Use floor integer division for the nonnegative window sum; positions without a full window receive -1.
Return one value per input element.
reference_solution:
def k_radius_averages(nums,k):
    width=2*k+1;answer=[-1]*len(nums)
    if width>len(nums):return answer
    window=sum(nums[:width]);answer[k]=window//width
    for right in range(width,len(nums)):
        window+=nums[right]-nums[right-width];answer[right-k]=window//width
    return answer
